Property.title: Property
Property.description: A real estate property listing managed in the control panel

title.description: The title or display name of the property

price.description: Formatted price of the property (e.g. Gs. 150.000.000)

priceRaw.description: Raw numeric price for calculation, sorting, and comparison

area.description: Area dimensions of the property (e.g., 12x30 ms)

description.description: Persuasive marketing copy or description (can be written by Gemini)

images.description: Array of Unsplash, Google Drive, or uploaded image URLs

video.description: Optional video presentation URL or local path

featured.description: Whether to display this property highlighted at the top

highlightFeature.description: Special attractive tag like 'Costa de Río' or 'A sola firma'

natureScore.description: Visual level of connection with nature (1 to 5)

amenities.description: List of key features, advantages, and amenities of the lot

hasTitle.description: Whether the property has clean legal title transfer papers ready

partnerAlias.description: Name or handle of the allied partner

partnerPhone.description: WhatsApp/cellular contact number of the partner

status.description: Listing status for validation and posting

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the property was listed

/properties/{propertyId}.description: Collection of all land and home listings available in the catalog
